description: CV Engineering Agent — Capability Registry. Machine-readable source. Keep consistent with spec/10-capability-registry.md.

capabilities.name: CV Requirements Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyse a Computer Vision problem statement to produce structured requirements: task type, performance targets, hardware constraints, dataset requirements, and deployment context.

required_inputs.name: problem_statement
required_inputs.description: Natural language description of the CV problem

required_inputs.name: hardware_targets
required_inputs.description: Target deployment hardware (e.g., A100, Jetson Orin, edge)

outputs.name: requirements_doc
outputs.description: Structured requirements: task type, KPIs, constraints

outputs.name: feasibility_notes
outputs.description: Initial feasibility observations

capabilities.name: CV Dataset Audit
capabilities.description: Inspect and characterise a Computer Vision dataset: class distribution, image quality, annotation consistency, coverage gaps, and data-leakage risks.

required_inputs.name: dataset_path
required_inputs.description: Path or URI to the dataset

outputs.name: audit_report
outputs.description: Dataset statistics, quality issues, and recommendations

outputs.name: split_summary
outputs.description: Train/val/test split statistics and class balance

capabilities.name: CV Model Selection
capabilities.description: Evaluate and recommend CV model architectures for a given task, considering accuracy/latency trade-offs, hardware targets, and available training data volume.

required_inputs.name: task_type
required_inputs.description: CV task (detection, segmentation, classification, pose, OCR, etc.)

required_inputs.name: data_volume
required_inputs.description: Approximate number of labelled training samples

outputs.name: architecture_shortlist
outputs.description: Ranked architectures with trade-off summary

outputs.name: recommendation
outputs.description: Recommended model and justification

capabilities.name: CV Training Pipeline Design
capabilities.description: Design a training pipeline: data augmentation strategy, loss functions, optimiser, LR schedule, mixed-precision settings, and distributed training topology.

required_inputs.name: compute_budget
required_inputs.description: Available GPU hours, memory, and parallelism

outputs.name: training_config
outputs.description: Complete training configuration (YAML/TOML)

outputs.name: pipeline_code
outputs.description: Training script skeleton with annotated decision points

capabilities.name: CV Model Evaluation
capabilities.description: Evaluate a trained CV model against a held-out test set. Compute task-appropriate metrics (mAP, mIoU, top-k accuracy, FPS) and produce per-class breakdowns, confusion analysis, and failure-case summaries.

required_inputs.name: metric_config
required_inputs.description: Metrics to compute and their thresholds

outputs.name: metrics_report
outputs.description: Metric values, per-class breakdown, and comparison to baseline

outputs.name: failure_analysis
outputs.description: Failure cases, confusion matrix, and error patterns

capabilities.name: CV Performance Benchmarking
capabilities.description: Run controlled performance benchmarks across hardware targets: throughput, latency percentiles, memory footprint, and power consumption.

required_inputs.name: model_artifact
required_inputs.description: Model file (checkpoint, ONNX, or TRT engine)

required_inputs.name: benchmark_config
required_inputs.description: Batch sizes, precision modes, warmup settings

outputs.name: benchmark_report
outputs.description: Latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput, memory, power per target

outputs.name: comparison_table
outputs.description: Cross-hardware performance comparison

capabilities.name: CV Model Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect model internals: parameter counts, layer structure, FLOPs, activation statistics, gradient flow, and interpretability visualisations (GradCAM, feature maps, attention maps).

required_inputs.name: model_checkpoint
required_inputs.description: Path to model checkpoint or ONNX file

required_inputs.name: sample_input
required_inputs.description: Representative input tensor for shape inference

outputs.name: model_profile
outputs.description: Parameter count, FLOPs, layer breakdown, memory estimate

outputs.name: visualisations
outputs.description: Feature maps, GradCAM, attention visualisations

capabilities.name: CV Deployment Optimization
capabilities.description: Optimise a trained CV model for target deployment: TensorRT engine building, quantisation (INT8/FP16), pruning, kernel fusion, and DeepStream pipeline integration.

required_inputs.name: model_artifact
required_inputs.description: ONNX or framework checkpoint to optimise

required_inputs.name: target_hardware
required_inputs.description: Deployment target (e.g., A100, Jetson Orin AGX)

required_inputs.name: calibration_dataset
required_inputs.description: Calibration data for INT8 quantisation (if applicable)

outputs.name: trt_engine
outputs.description: Optimised TensorRT engine file

outputs.name: optimization_report
outputs.description: Speedup, accuracy delta, and configuration details

outputs.name: deepstream_config
outputs.description: DeepStream pipeline configuration (if applicable)

capabilities.name: CV Research Survey
capabilities.description: Survey the research literature for a given CV problem: identify state-of-the-art methods, summarise key papers, compare approaches, and produce a structured literature review with implementation links.

required_inputs.name: recency_window
required_inputs.description: How recent the papers should be (e.g., '2 years')

outputs.name: literature_review
outputs.description: Structured survey of methods, results, and comparisons

outputs.name: sota_table
outputs.description: State-of-the-art benchmark results table

outputs.name: implementation_links
outputs.description: Links to reference implementations and pretrained models

capabilities.name: CV Problem Formulation
capabilities.description: Translate business requirements into an explicit CV problem formulation and system-level event definition.

outputs.name: problem_formulation
outputs.description: Chosen CV formulation with alternatives, assumptions and rationale

capabilities.name: CV Knowledge Retrieval
capabilities.description: Retrieve grounded project, technology and research knowledge with provenance and freshness metadata.

outputs.name: evidence_set
outputs.description: Ranked evidence records with provenance

capabilities.name: CV Research Verification
capabilities.description: Verify material claims using authoritative or primary evidence and record verification status.

outputs.name: verification_report
outputs.description: Verified, partially verified, contradicted and unverified claims

capabilities.name: Capability and Skill Resolution
capabilities.description: Resolve a selected capability into applicable installed skills, tools, workers and knowledge sources.

outputs.name: execution_plan
outputs.description: Resolved skills, tools, workers, prerequisites and policy requirements

capabilities.name: CV Experiment Management
capabilities.description: Create, track, compare and lineage-link reproducible CV experiments and decisions.

required_inputs.name: experiment_definition
required_inputs.description: Experiment objective, hypothesis, configuration and budget

outputs.name: experiment_record
outputs.description: Persistent experiment record with lineage and results

capabilities.name: CV Baseline Establishment
capabilities.description: Create a reproducible baseline configuration and measurement record before optimization.

outputs.name: baseline_record
outputs.description: Immutable reference configuration and measurements

capabilities.name: CV Failure Analysis
capabilities.description: Classify model and system failures, identify probable causes and generate targeted follow-up experiments.

outputs.name: failure_analysis
outputs.description: Failure taxonomy, root-cause hypotheses and remediation proposals

capabilities.name: CV Deployment Validation
capabilities.description: Validate a deployed CV system against functional, performance, reliability and operational acceptance criteria.

outputs.name: deployment_validation
outputs.description: Validation results and release recommendation

capabilities.name: Platform Detection
capabilities.description: Detect operating system, architecture, CPU, GPU/accelerator, drivers, runtimes and Jetson-specific platform metadata.

outputs.name: platform_profile
outputs.description: Structured verified platform profile

capabilities.name: Platform Verification
capabilities.description: Verify that required drivers, runtimes, toolkits and framework accelerator backends are installed, compatible and usable.

outputs.name: compatibility_report
outputs.description: Verified compatibility and missing/incompatible components

capabilities.name: Platform Optimization
capabilities.description: Select and validate platform-specific acceleration, precision, profiling, resource and runtime optimizations against measured constraints.

outputs.name: optimization_profile
outputs.description: Platform-specific optimization plan and measured result
